messages:
alex: FYI - paging incident from earlier (svc-token-proxy errors) has been stabilized and customer-facing impact contained. Creating a postmortem thread to coordinate RCA, timeline, and action items. @maya can you take primary drafter?

maya: I can take the draft. Can we capture the exact mitigation timeline + who did the live mitigation so I can quote it in the impact summary?

sam: I was oncall when this hit. Short version: at ~08:12 we started seeing 502s from token proxy, error rate spiked to ~45% for a ~9m window. Autoscale didn't kick because the LB health checks kept failing. I triggered the manual scaling and rolled a hotfix to revert the last config change.

jen: Adding some numbers for customer impact: about 1,200 requests failed from 09 customers (mostly 3 mid-market accounts) during the spike window. No data leaked. SLA blips for 2 customers. I'll verify with billing if any credits needed.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20240312-72. Pager routed to oncall alex -> sam; mitigation runbook invoked: token-proxy-restart v2. Logs uploaded to: https://redwood-internal/ops/logs/INC-72.zip

ryan: Quick note: I saw a config rollout in infra CI at 08:05 that modified healthcheck threshold for proxy (timeout from 1s -> 3s). Suspect that change + a transient backend latency caused the LB to mark backends unhealthy, which prevented autoscaling from responding.

alex: Good context. maya, draft should include: timeline, contributing factors (config change, healthcheck semantics, autoscaler guardrail), impact (customers/requests/SLA), remediation plan (short/long term), and owners for action items.

maya: Will do. Proposed schedule: draft by EOD today, peer review tomorrow morning, sign-off by product and legal by Friday. Who can review? @jen for impact + billing, @ryan for infra details, @alex for mitigation narrative.

sam: I can review infra + timeline tomorrow morning. Also attaching the snippet I pulled from the proxy logs:

```
[08:11:57] ERROR upstream timeout for request id=abc123 status=504
[08:12:02] WARN healthcheck failing on 10.10.3.14: timeout after 1s
[08:12:15] ERROR 502 returned to client id=xyz987
```

maya: thanks. I'll put that in the timeline. For evidence, can someone drop the deploy CI link and the config diff? Need to reference the exact change.

ryan: CI link: https://ci.redwood/reports/8234. Config diff (excerpt):

```
- healthcheck.timeout: 1s
+ healthcheck.timeout: 3s
```

jen: For customer impact section I'll add list of affected accounts (redacted here): acct-241, acct-802, acct-410. I'll also add the tentative SLA impact numbers (minutes of unavailable requests).

alex: Action items (initial draft) - please assign owners and ETA: 
- A1: Revert healthcheck change in canary and add safety gating (owner: ryan) - ETA: 24h
- A2: Update autoscaler to consider connection queue depth not just LB health (owner: sam) - ETA: 2 weeks
- A3: Postmortem draft + evidence upload (owner: maya) - ETA: EOD today
- A4: Customer comms and billing impact estimate (owner: jen) - ETA: tomorrow EOD
- A5: Add synthetic test for proxy healthchecks in staging (owner: alex) - ETA: 1 week

maya: I'll add these as TODOs in the doc and create a tracked issue in the incident board. Any tweaks?

sam: A2: can we split into A2a (short-term tweak to autoscaler thresholds) ETA 3 days and A2b (long-term queue depth metric) ETA 2 weeks? I'll own both.

ryan: Sounds good. For A1, I'll do a partial revert to canary first and monitor for 1 hour before full rollout. I'll paste the rollback commands:

```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/token-proxy --to-revision=42
kubectl -n infra rollout status deploy/token-proxy
```

jen: On customer comms: recommend a holding statement for sales until we confirm SLA numbers. I'll draft a short note and ping legal for review.

maya: Timeline for draft: I'll publish v0 with timeline + evidence by 18:00 and ping reviewers. After peer review I'll fold in remediation details.

incident-bot: Update: rollback to revision 42 initiated by ryan at 08:42. Healthchecks normalized by 08:45. Incident marked mitigated at 08:51.

alex: Thanks - that mitigation timeline looks right. maya when you post the v0 please include the following sections as headings: 
- Executive summary (1-2 paragraphs)
- Impact summary (metrics + account list)
- Timeline (minute-granular)
- Root cause analysis (contributing factors)
- Remediation (short + long term)
- Action item tracker (owners + due dates)
- Evidence/attachments (logs, diffs, CI links)

maya: Will do. One last ask - can legal sign the final before we publish externally? @jen can you loop legal?

jen: Yep, I'll loop legal and product after the peer review. Also tagging billing.

sam: I'll add a short reproduction test + runbook update once the draft is done. Will drop a link to the updated runbook in the RFC.

maya: Alright publishing v0 now -> https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-72-v0. Please leave inline comments in the doc. I'll collect and merge feedback by 10:30 tomorrow.

alex: Great. After signoff let's schedule a 30m postmortem review with Eng/Prod/Sales. Proposed time: Friday 11:00 PST. Who's available?

jen: I'm available.

sam: available.

ryan: available.

maya: available.

alex: OK scheduling invite. Closing thread for active updates; please use the doc/issue for action tracking. If anything new crops up ping me directly. :thumbsup:
